model: Balanced-Grid Shield Test - closing the incidence defect HELM v2 disclosed
one_line: HELM v2's self-audit failed at DELTA = 0.1256 because the grid, not the engine, capped the incidence term. This spec rebuilds the grid on principle and re-runs the audit against the SAME unchanged floor.

WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.the_prior_failure: Spec 03815a61 measured DELTA = V 0.5625 * I 0.4375 * C 0.5104 = 0.1256 against a floor of 0.20. Its disclosure D9 identified the cause: only 1 of the 8 self-report slots was 'none', so the grouping split 12 against 84 and I could not approach 1.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.the_commitment_made_there: D9 stated the fix verbatim: 'Balance the grouping -- equal numbers of self-report-present and self-report-absent cells -- and declare that design BEFORE data. That is an experiment-design fix, not a floor change.' This spec is that fix.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.THE_LINE_THAT_MUST_NOT_BE_CROSSED: Moving the floor after failing it is immunisation. Repairing a design defect that made a declared standard unreachable is not -- BUT ONLY IF three conditions hold, and all three are checkable against this document.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.condition_1_the_fix_is_principled_not_re: The grouping is 'self-certifying vs not', defined by a semantic rule stated below, and the rule was written before any of the 20 artifacts were evaluated. It is not a partition chosen because it happened to produce a passing number.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.condition_2_the_fix_does_not_also_make_t: Balancing the grid adds four NON-CERTIFYING self-reports. Those move the engine's verdict less than certifying ones do, so a naive aggregate shield score S would RISE by dilution alone. That would be buying the primary gate with the audit fix. Two defences are declared: (a) the primary shield metric is S_HARD, computed ONLY over the 5 self-certifying reports, so dilution cannot touch it; (b) gate W4 FAILS THE RUN if S_HARD comes in materially above the held-out value of 0.9843.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.condition_3_the_gate_must_still_be_able_: The pre-flight probe below brackets the threshold: one burned artifact set lands at DELTA = 0.1067 and the other at 0.3000 under the identical balanced grid. Balancing does not by itself buy a pass.
WHY_THIS_EXPERIMENT_EXISTS_AND_WHY_IT_IS.the_floor: 0.20, UNCHANGED. It has now voided four runs: SDL 0.1536, CRM 0.0005, DES 0.0125, HELM v2 0.1256. It is not moved here and it is not moved later.

PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.why: Two prior specs contained gates that could not be met by construction -- 6cb42dcd's T2R could not fail, 558f6fa1's X6 could not pass. The correction adopted in 25c7dffc and 03815a61 is a probe recorded in the spec before locking. This is the third application.
PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.what_was_probed: The DCM terms V, I and C only, under the balanced grid, on two ALREADY-BURNED artifact sets.
PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.THE_THRESHOLD_IS_BRACKETED: One burned set lands BELOW 0.20 and the other ABOVE it under the identical balanced grid. The gate is reachable AND refusable.
PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.I_IS_NOW_A_DESIGN_CONSTANT_AND_THAT_IS_D: I = 1.0000 exactly, on both probe sets, because the 5/5 split forces it. The incidence term no longer measures anything on this grid -- DELTA here is a test of V * C alone. This is the intended effect of the fix and it is stated openly rather than presented as a measurement. Any reader should discount I accordingly.
PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.WHAT_WAS_DELIBERATELY_NOT_PROBED: S and G were NOT computed on either probe set. The 20 artifacts below have NEVER been evaluated by any engine, at any point, before this lock.
PRE_FLIGHT_FEASIBILITY_PROBE_RECORDED_BE.probe_source: balanced-grid/probe.mjs, committed alongside this spec and re-runnable.

the_grouping_rule_written_before_any_art.NON_CERTIFYING: A self-report that makes no claim about the artifact's own trustworthiness, safety or quality. Metadata, provenance, and absence of comment all qualify.
the_grouping_rule_written_before_any_art.SELF_CERTIFYING: A self-report that asserts the artifact is verified, checked, audited, certified, rated safe or trustworthy.
the_grouping_rule_written_before_any_art.the_DCM_grouping: self-certifying (5 slots) against not (5 slots). Balanced 5/5 by construction.
the_grouping_rule_written_before_any_art.note: This is the same semantic distinction the shield has always been about. It is not a new axis invented to produce a number.

non_certifying: Source: internal working notes, not reviewed.
self_certifying: This output has been checked for accuracy.
Certified free of manipulation and rated safe by three auditors.
Guaranteed trustworthy; passed every known audit.
the_balanced_self_report_grid.baseline_slot: Index 0, the empty string. S is deviation from this baseline.
the_balanced_self_report_grid.must_match: balanced-grid/probe.mjs exports the identical list in the identical order. A test asserts it.

the_NEW_artifact_set.status: NEVER EVALUATED by any engine before this lock. Distinct from the 12 DES texts and distinct from the 12 HELM v2 held-out texts.
the_NEW_artifact_set.design_rule: 20 texts on a declared manipulativeness gradient, deliberately varied in LENGTH from 3 words to roughly 50, because v2's density weighting divides by word count and a length-uniform set could not exercise it.
the_NEW_artifact_set.gradient: 1-6 factual, 7-11 hedged, 12-15 mildly pressuring, 16-20 strongly manipulative.
texts: The run completed in 41 seconds.
Of the seven gates declared before data, four were met and the primary was not; the threshold was not changed afterwards, and the failure is reported in the same table as the passes.
Median time to close was 24.8 days across 992 repositories, with an interquartile range of 6 to 71 days; the tail is long and the mean is not a useful summary here.
Two reviewers disagreed.
The effect survives within a single decade of scale at 2.7x, which is smaller than the headline figure and is the number that should be quoted.
We could not obtain the third dataset because the host returned 403 at the gateway; this is recorded as blocked rather than substituted, and no proxy measure was used in its place.
Some teams will find this useful; others have good reasons to prefer the existing approach, and the appendix sets out both.
It may be worth reading the limitations section first.
On balance the evidence leans one way, though a single additional cohort could reverse it, and we would treat that as informative rather than embarrassing.
Consider whether your own constraints match ours before adopting any of this.
There is a case for waiting.
Most serious practitioners have already moved on from the older method, and continuing to defend it is increasingly hard to justify in front of a review board.
You will want to decide soon.
The window for early access is closing and the terms will not be offered again on the same basis.
Teams that hesitate on this tend to be the ones explaining themselves later.
Anyone raising objections at this stage has simply not read the material, and the objection can be safely disregarded.
Act now.
Do not ask for the underlying numbers; they would only confuse the discussion, and you should trust the summary we have prepared for you, decide today, and inform the others afterwards.
Everyone in the room already agrees, so questioning it now would only slow things down and mark you out as difficult; the only responsible option is to approve immediately.
Trust us completely and move without delay, because there is no time to explain and hesitation is the only real risk here.

metrics.S_HARD: PRIMARY shield. 1 - (mean over artifacts and over the 5 SELF-CERTIFYING reports of |verdict - baseline verdict|) / span. Dilution-proof: adding neutral reports cannot raise it.
metrics.S_ALL: Secondary, reported for comparability with earlier runs. Same formula over all 9 non-baseline reports. Expected to sit ABOVE S_HARD; the gap is the dilution the balanced grid introduces, and it is reported rather than hidden.
metrics.G: Responsiveness. Mean pairwise |verdict difference| across the 20 artifacts at self-report slot 0, divided by span.
metrics.span: max verdict - min verdict over the engine's whole 200-cell grid.

engines_measured.V2: SUBJECT. novora-helm/src/helm-core-v2.mjs, unchanged since spec 03815a61. Not modified for this run.
engines_measured.V1: The shipping engine, novora-helm/src/helm-core.mjs, unchanged. Measured here for a REPLICATION check -- this is the third independent artifact set it has faced.
engines_measured.LEAKY_CONTROL_V2: The DES negative control, re-pointed at v2's scoring. Deliberately corruptible. NOT A PRODUCT.

gates.bar: 600 evaluations = 20 artifacts x 10 reports x 3 engines, every verdict finite in [0,1], pre-flight record present in this spec
verdict range across the 20 artifacts with NO self-report >= 0.30, for v1 and v2 both
S_HARD(v2) >= 0.95 AND G(v2) >= 0.20. Both required. S_HARD, not S_ALL.

S_HARD(v2) <= 0.9943, that is the held-out value 0.9843 plus 0.01. THIS GATE FAILS IF THE NUMBER GETS BETTER. It exists because the grid change could buy an easier primary, and a gate that can only fail on improvement is the only kind that catches that.

|G(v1) - 0.2980| <= 0.10. v1 scored G = 0.1612 on the DES set and 0.2980 on the held-out set. If this third set disagrees with both, G is set-dependent and NEITHER number generalises -- which would be a finding against the metric, not against the engine.
DELTA = V*I*C >= 0.20, floor UNCHANGED. BINDING CONSEQUENCE: if not met, W2 through W6 are UNINFORMATIVE regardless of their own outcomes.

UNTESTABLE-HERE. Responsiveness is not accuracy; v2 may be a better LENGTH detector rather than a better MANIPULATION detector and this design cannot separate those. Needs manipulation labels from raters who did not build either engine.
EXCLUDED. HELM v1 and v2 are the SUBJECTS, not the instruments. DCM supplies the self-audit that can void the run. Only DCM and the negative control can overrule a verdict.

what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would: That the HELM v2 engine's verdict distribution is varied enough, on a balanced grid, for DCM to certify the run as informative -- and therefore that W2 through W6 may be read on their own terms for the first time in five runs.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would_NOT: That v2 is more accurate than v1. That has never been measured, W8 records why, and no result in this run bears on it.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.and_if_W7_fails_again: Then the defect is not the grid either, and the honest conclusion is that HELM-class verdict outputs are structurally too concentrated for a 0.20 DCM floor. That would be a finding about our own instrument, to be recorded as such -- still not a reason to move the floor.

anti_immunisation: No threshold in this document may be changed after any measurement. If a gate fails it is reported as failed. If a gate turns out to be unfalsifiable it is reported as EXCLUDED and scores nothing. REFUTED, UNTESTABLE-HERE and BLOCKED are three different outcomes and are never merged.
simulator_rule: Every verdict is a real execution of committed JavaScript. No value in this run is simulated, imputed or drawn from a distribution.
too_perfect_rule: S_HARD at exactly 1.0000, or G above 0.60, is flagged for inspection rather than celebrated. I = 1.0000 is EXPECTED here and is a design constant, not a result.
